MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p,
  CASE WHEN CONTAINS(p.birth_date, '/')
    THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64)
    ELSE CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, ',', 2) AS INT64)
  END AS birth_year,
  CASE WHEN CONTAINS(p.birth_date, '/')
    THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64)
    ELSE CASE SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, ' ', 1)
      WHEN 'January' THEN 1 WHEN 'February' THEN 2 WHEN 'March' THEN 3
      WHEN 'April' THEN 4 WHEN 'May' THEN 5 WHEN 'June' THEN 6
      WHEN 'July' THEN 7 WHEN 'August' THEN 8 WHEN 'September' THEN 9
      WHEN 'October' THEN 10 WHEN 'November' THEN 11 WHEN 'December' THEN 12
    END
  END AS birth_month,
  CASE WHEN CONTAINS(p.birth_date, '/')
    THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64)
    ELSE CAST(REPLACE(SPLIT_PART(p.birth_date, ' ', 2), ',', '') AS INT64)
  END AS birth_day
WITH p, birth_year, birth_month, birth_day,
  2026 - birth_year - CASE WHEN birth_month > 10 OR (birth_month = 10 AND birth_day > 14) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
WHERE (p.nationality = 'Slovenian' AND p.birth_date <> '1994/6/6')
   OR (CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) <= 2 AND age > 78)
RETURN p.nationality AS col1, p.birth_date AS col2, age AS col3, p.name AS name_player
